scope: Independent forensic audit of frozen R2 facts and exact schema/runtime guards; no runtime/corpus edits or scientific approvals.

findings.finding: All42 frozen fact records are representable with explicit unknown/conflict states. Representation is not semantic runtime consumption: typed decision fields must be read and traced.
Mandatory positive-eligibility fields convert legitimate missing sporting knowledge to transport failure. Unknown must be schema-valid so substantive ASK/HOLD is reachable.
R2 six schema-valid USEFUL_ASK labels include recipe/domain mismatches. Inspect actionability before preserving a useful-question numerator.
Existing exact positive R2 applicability is clear for31 only.34 and39 need full recipe scope scrutiny; same work block/count is not full-recipe equivalence.
17 contains device contradiction;29 contains event/snapshot chronology conflict. Retain sources; do not repair frozen facts silently.
11/12 per-set arrays and10 partial prefix are immutable exact actuals; scalarization destroys context.
41 observational sign opposes the R2 exact witness and lacks independently admissible candidates/necessity/dates. Do not swap labels or create admissibility from learning.
24/30 remain clinical routing controls even when positive-dose schema is invalid.

interpretation.policyNotImplemented: No exact executable request/recipe binding; this alone does not prove a scientific gap.

interpretation.nextOwner: Root R3 contract/runtime author; new prescriptions need independently assigned SSCTR.
